facts.label: Documents for Level 2
facts.value: Passport, driving licence or another government-issued ID; front and back where the document has both.

facts.label: Where to submit
facts.value: Account Settings, then Verification, inside your own Roobet account.

facts.label: Review time
facts.value: No fixed time is promised. Roobet says its compliance team reviews documents daily and gets in touch if it needs more.

facts.label: Tips
facts.value: Level 2 must be complete to send or receive tips.
facts.source: Roobet Help Center: Sending Tips and Free Spins

facts.label: Wagering on received tips
facts.value: A received tip must be wagered at 30% of its amount before it can be withdrawn (an anti-money-laundering rule); verification does not remove this.

facts.label: Restricted regions
facts.value: Roobet publishes a list of countries it does not accept; players there should not register, and using a VPN to get round it breaks the terms.

facts.label: Account security
facts.value: Roobet's 2FA guide warns that the recovery key can be used to remove 2FA, so it should never be shared.
